decision.reason: MSIT/KDI ministry announcement confirms proposed dataset hub linkage with exemptions and quality duties; potential human-evidence preparation workflow.

opportunities.idea_name: Korea AI-Hub Data Release Preflight Desk
opportunities.core_job: Prepare datasets and exemption evidence for planned AI-Hub data-sharing requirements
opportunities.target_customer: Korean publicly funded AI dataset producers and government project data stewards
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual project dataset metadata, rights/secret/privacy exemption checklists, data-quality status, source, officer signoff and review-ready export; no automatic data upload or legal opinion
opportunities.why_now: Korea MSIT 13 October announced Cabinet approval of proposed AI Basic Act/Data Industry Act amendments to connect publicly funded training datasets to AI-Hub, with protected exceptions and quality obligations; not yet enacted.
opportunities.before_state: Producers lack a unified readiness file connecting ownership, privacy exceptions, metadata and quality.
opportunities.after_state: Versioned dataset preflight case and exemption/quality evidence report awaiting enacted implementation rules.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Client-side structured checklist; validation still required
